leading_positions.synthesis: All six round-1 configurations are a single-part prize on B036 with the same laureates (Drucker, Holst, Mojsov) and a citation framed around GLP-1 physiology, its active forms and the resulting incretin-based therapy of type 2 diabetes and obesity. Linnarsson and Sandberg moved to this trio from Drucker, Holst and Knudsen in their openings, and each states the Knudsen version remains defensible. Shared: the physiology-first framing and the view that the drug-development contribution is acknowledged in the citation wording rather than by a named laureate. Not shared: the weight placed on Mojsov's contested priority versus Knudsen's engineering, and whether a second prize part is desirable. No member's round-1 configuration includes a second part.

areas_of_agreement: B036 is the only shortlisted candidate placed first by all six members, and each round-1 statement grounds this in content: proglucagon processing, the active GLP-1 peptides, human incretin physiology, and independent randomized outcome benefit in diabetes, obesity, cardiovascular and renal disease.
Maturity of B036 is not questioned by any member; the interpretation is described as stable and independently confirmed.
Habener is not among the credited names, and every member flags this as a limitation of any trio drawn from the supplied credit.
Mojsov's priority on the active peptide is described as contested or unverified by every member, and all say their recollection of priority is not checked against the supplied evidence.
Several members (Linnarsson, Sandberg, Perlmann, Wahren-Herlenius) treat a single GLP-1 part as the baseline from which any alternative or second part would have to be argued.
scientific_disputes: Whether the prize should reward the discovery of GLP-1 biology and the active peptide, or the therapeutic arc including long-acting analogue design. El-Manira, Perlmann, Sandberg, Svenningsson and Wahren-Herlenius lean to the physiology framing; Linnarsson says the Knudsen version would be better if the Committee values transformation of care as much as discovery.

Whether a methods advance fits the prize: optogenetics (B042) is named as an alternative by El-Manira, Perlmann, Sandberg and Svenningsson, with the tool-versus-discovery concern and six credited names raised in the file.

Whether the unfolded protein response (B006), named as an alternative by El-Manira, Linnarsson, Perlmann, Sandberg and Svenningsson, should be preferred for its conceptual clarity despite indirect and still developing clinical impact, and whether the PERK and ATF6 arms are adequately represented.
Which of B031, B047, B026 or B042 would pair best with B036 if a second part is wanted. Alternatives named include B031 and B047 (Wahren-Herlenius), B047 (Linnarsson), B042 and B006 (others).
attribution_disputes: Third B036 laureate: Mojsov (all six round-1 configurations) versus Knudsen (the openings of Linnarsson and Sandberg, still treated as a live alternative in several statements). The three-person limit cannot hold all four credited names.

Habener is outside the credited names yet is cited by El-Manira, Linnarsson, Perlmann, Sandberg, Svenningsson and Wahren-Herlenius as having a real claim to the early peptide work. Perlmann asks that this limitation be noted when the citation is worded.
B042 (optogenetics) credits six names for three places.
B047 (CAR-T): Eshhar is absent from the credited names, raised by Linnarsson and Wahren-Herlenius.

B026 (BCR-ABL): members' responses describe the earlier BCR-ABL fusion and oncogene work and the imatinib chemistry as outside the credited trio, and El-Manira and Wahren-Herlenius question whether it then rewards development rather than discovery. B026 is not in anyone's round-1 alternatives list.
B031 (TNF blockade): El-Manira and Svenningsson's responses note that cytokine cloning, characterisation and antibody engineering lie outside the credited pair.
maturity_disputes: B036: no maturity dispute is raised in any statement.
B006: clinical impact is described as still developing, so the fit is conceptual rather than therapeutic.
B047: Linnarsson cites unresolved solid-tumour and long-term toxicity questions.

B031: Wahren-Herlenius's uncertainties ask whether TNF blockade is late recognition or fully mature and timely, and Svenningsson's response notes the principle has partly been absorbed into later cytokine therapies.
B042: impact is described as largely as a research instrument rather than directly medical.
conflict_or_recusal_flags: No member discloses a specific conflict with any credited name on the shortlist.

Documented collaborations disclosed as unrelated to credited names: Svenningsson with Perlmann and Greengard, Perlmann with Evans, Ericson, Svenningsson and El-Manira, Sandberg with Linnarsson and Frisen, El-Manira with Perlmann, Grillner and Ernfors.

El-Manira notes that his motor-circuit field is close to B042, and Wahren-Herlenius notes that her field is close to B031 and loosely B014. Both state this is topical proximity, not a documented tie, and Wahren-Herlenius would re-flag it if B031 became a serious option.
Shared Karolinska Institutet affiliation is not treated as a conflict by any member who raises it.
questions_for_round2: Is the citation to reward the discovery of GLP-1 physiology and its active forms, or the creation of long-acting incretin therapies? Which criterion should settle the third B036 slot?

If the physiology framing is adopted, can Mojsov's contribution to identifying the active peptide be supported from the supplied evidence? If not, will members who said they would move to Knudsen do so, and who else would?
How should the Committee record the absence of Habener from the credited names, in the citation wording or in the deliberation record?

Is B036 to stand alone as a single-part prize, or should a second part be added? If a second part, which of B006, B042, B031 or B047 would members support, and does the three-person limit leave room for it?
For B042, can six credited names be reduced to three on discovery grounds, and does the methods-versus-discovery concern disqualify it?
For B026, B031 and B047, does the foundational work outside the credited names weaken the candidacy, and should the same principle be applied consistently to B036?
Do members who named B006 as an alternative see it as a replacement for B036 if the GLP-1 allocation stalls, or only as a second part?
summary.chair_observation: The six round-1 configurations are identical in ballot and laureates, so round 1 shows no disagreement over the leading position. The open issues are the third-name rationale (physiology versus development), the standing of Mojsov's contested priority, Habener's uncredited position, and whether the final configuration has a second part. Several members state that their priority recollections are unverified and not checked against the supplied evidence. I count only positions explicit in the six files and infer no hidden votes.
